explanation: Both packages use identical _compute_centrality_local code. It calls NetworkX HITS (SciPy svds) and eigenvector_centrality_numpy (ARPACK eigs) without a fixed start vector. The tiny differences are consistent with numerical variation in these iterative spectral solvers; input probability matrices, P-values and sparse structure are exactly equal. The original 1e-12 absolute/relative tolerance was not changed.
